Help me pick a laptop under 80,000 rupees for programming
4:15 PM

For programming under ₹80,000 aim for 16 GB memory, a 512 GB SSD and a recent Ryzen 5/7 or Intel Core i5/i7 processor.

Memory: 16 GB is the floor, and 8 GB gets tight with an editor, browser and Docker open. Pick one that can be upgraded.
Screen and keyboard: Full HD, IPS, 14 to 15.6 inches, with a comfortable keyboard. You'll look at it all day.
Battery: Look for 8+ hours in real reviews, not just the listed figure.
Graphics card: Skip it unless you'll do AI training or games. That money is better spent on memory and a good screen.
